name: Paraty and Ilha Grande – Culture and Biodiversity
description: On Brazil's Costa Verde, this site pairs the colonial port town of Paraty with the rainforested mountains and bays around Ilha Grande. Paraty kept its 18th-century street plan and colonial buildings from the days when gold from the interior was shipped out here. Nearby, Atlantic Forest shelters jaguars, peccaries and the rare southern muriqui monkey.
